name: Bulldog
subtitle: Flex offense: basic motion
goal: Keep screening and cutting until someone gets a layup or an open elbow jump shot.
options: Best: the flex cutter at the block. Next: the screener popping up to the elbow. Nothing? Reverse it and run it the other way.

steps.note: 1 passes to 2 at the other high elbow. That pass starts everything.
5 steps out and sets the flex screen for 4 in the corner.
Flex cut: 4 cuts along the baseline off 5's screen to the other block. 2 looks for the layup pass.
Screen the screener: 1 sets a down screen for 5.
5 comes off the down screen up to the high elbow for the jump shot. 1 goes out to the corner.
Nothing there? It starts over on the other side: 2 passes to 5 at the other high elbow.
Same motion, opposite side: 4 steps out and sets the flex screen for 3. Next, 3 makes the flex cut and 2 screens down for 4.
